issues.title: [CI Failure]: Multimodal Processor shards - test_tensor_schema[naver-hyperclovax/HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Think-32B] - upstream model_type hyperclovax_vision_v2 unknown to CI transformers
issues.author: kaijunli-infr
issues.body_head:
### Name of failing test

`models/multimodal/processing/test_tensor_schema.py::test_model_tensor_schema[naver-hyperclovax/HyperCLOVAX-SEED-Think-32B]`

### Basic information

- Jobs: every `Multimodal Processor` shard containing this model — observed on `computer-cpu-multimodal-processor-shard-2`, `shard-4`, `nvidia-h200-mig-18gb-multimodal-processor`, and `amd-mi355-multimodal-processor` in build 88212 (PR #52101, which does not touch multimodal code).
- Deterministic, hardware-independent, and survives retries: the cause is external to the repo.

### Description

The upstream Hugging Face repo changed its `model_type` to `hyperclovax_vision_v2`, which the transformers version in the CI images does not recognize, so `ModelConfig` validation fails:

```text
pydantic_core._pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for ModelConfig
  Value error, The checkpoint you are trying to load has model type `hyperclovax_vision_v2` but Transformers does not recognize this architecture.
```

153/154 tests in each shard pass; only this model fails.

### Possible fixes

Pin the test to a fixed revision of the HF repo, update/upgrade transformers in the CI image, or temporarily skip this model id in `test_tensor_schema`.
